headline: Johnvents Industries Closes Oversubscribed ₦80B Commercial Paper
summary: Johnvents Industries Limited successfully closed its ₦80 billion Series 1 Commercial Paper issuance under a ₦250 billion programme, attracting subscriptions above the target.
why: Commercial paper issuances provide companies with short-term debt financing from institutional investors to support operational liquidity and growth plans.

impacts.name: Johnvents Industries Limited
impacts.why: Oversubscribed debt issuances demonstrate strong institutional credit appetite and liquidity access for the issuer.
